guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_diskio went from a baseline of 0 to about 4022 (the largest anomaly by far), and its latency-50 rose 859% while its socket count and CPU rose moderately. Upstream callers (checkoutservice and frontend latency) degrade afterward, and the slow traces all pass through currencyservice; the logs have no warnings or errors to contradict this.

proposed_fix.description: Find and throttle or stop the process generating heavy disk I/O in the currencyservice pod, then restart or reschedule the pod onto a node with healthy storage if the I/O does not subside. Verify that currencyservice latency and diskio return to baseline.
